verdict.rationale: Anytype's first-party agents skill says an AI agent can run scripts against Anytype data to handle bulk edits, transformations, and repetitive tasks, so bulk operation is a documented capability. It works through agent-run scripts over the local API, and nothing shows native bulk tooling or how well it holds up at scale. Missing for 10: a documented batch or bulk API endpoint, in-app multi-select bulk actions, details on scale or transactional behavior of bulk edits, and independent hands-on corroboration.
